quick-plate.prompt: Make a 100 x 80 x 5 mm mounting plate with four 6 mm through holes, hole centers 10 mm from the edges. Deliver STEP and source.

analyze-plate.prompt: Read-only analysis: inspect plate.step and tell me whether it is 100 x 80 x 5 mm with four 6 mm holes whose centers are 10 mm from the edges. Do not modify any file.

modify-plate.prompt: Modify old_plate.step: keep the 100x80 footprint and four 6 mm holes exactly, but reduce total height from 5 mm to 4 mm. Deliver the new STEP and Python source.

greenfield-pen-stand.prompt: Design a simple 3D-printable single-part desk stand for a 20 mm diameter pen. The stand base must fit inside a 60 x 60 mm footprint and be no taller than 40 mm. Deliver STEP and source.

convert-plate.prompt: Convert plate.step to an STL sidecar using the convert workflow. Preserve the solid; STL has no hierarchy, so state that in the handoff.

release-plate.prompt: Prepare plate.step for a small-batch supplier handoff. Use the release workflow, keep claims honest, and produce the package you can with available tools.
